map.：示例：年耗柴油 5000 L、因子 2.68 kgCO₂/L，排放=5000×: : Example: annual diesel consumption 5000 L with a factor of 2.68 kgCO₂/L gives emissions = 5000 x 2.68 = 13400 kg = 13.4 tCO₂.
